title: Spiked Shield
body:
![Surface level stat showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89824b2559f9c2d73ab1d131ae0dbed30f847ba3.png)

### Important!
This datapack requires a [resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spiked-shield/version/1.0), which is needed for proper visuals
### About
The Spiked Shield crafted with Copper and Amethyst, is designed to be a decent alternative to the vanilla Shield, prioritizing offense instead of complete defense.

When blocking, it damages anything approaching you, and gives partial damage reduction.
It has a lower durability, gets disabled for less time by axe strikes, and has a smaller movement penalty when using.

### Stats
| Items               | When blocking         | Durability           | Time Disabled | Speed penalty when using
|---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:|---------------------:|---------------------:|
| Spiked Shield       | 60% DMG reduction + DMG every 4 ticks        | 190             | 4s | 60%
| Shield              | 100% DMG reduction                           | 336             | 5s | 80%
